races.name: Watch On Racing TV Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ELM CREEK has shown enough in 2 hurdles starts to land a race of this nature. Guevara may prove the biggest danger on the back of his Flat form, with Irish raider Shushi the type to improve on her recent debut in this sphere.

  1. ELM CREEK (IRE)
  2. GUEVARA (GER)
  3. SHUSHI

races.name: Musselburgh Racecourse Premium Annual Membership Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
FLASH DU PISTOLET has gradually edged back down to his last winning mark and can end his losing run with a recent outing behind him. Chasing debut winner Nevershedatear should go close in her attempt to follow up, whilst Humble Jumble isn't one to completely rule out.

  1. FLASH DU PISTOLET (IRE)
  2. NEVERSHEDATEAR (IRE)
  3. HUMBLE JUMBLE (IRE)

races.name: Protech Network Solutions Ltd Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An excellent opportunity for NOVAK to make a winning start for Olly Murphy. Hunters Spring gets the nod over Oor Wish for the forecast.

  1. NOVAK (FR)
  2. HUNTERS SPRING
  3. OOR WISH (IRE)

races.name: 100% Racing TV Profits Back To Racing Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GINTIME makes plenty of appeal at the weights, and she can deny Iamyouare a third win on the bounce.

  1. GINTIME (IRE)
  2. IAMYOUARE (IRE)
  3. SNOWROCCO (IRE)

races.name: Musselburgh Racecourse 2027 Annual Membership Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This could well turn into a tactical race but the vote goes to 4-y-o MASTERFIELD who recently made an encouraging chasing debut at Bangor and looks the type to build on that. Laristote finished behind the selection last time and can chase him home.

  1. MASTERFIELD (FR)
  2. LARISTOTE (FR)
  3. MAGNOLIA (FR)

races.name: Edinburgh Rugby 1872 Cup Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SCOTS POET looks the percentage call as he bids for win number 5 this year. Front-running Nobotheratall is the main threat in a tricky 6-runner handicap, with Gemini Man very much respected on his course form from last winter.

  1. SCOTS POET
  2. NOBOTHERATALL (IRE)
  3. GEMINI MAN (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WALK ON SON has fallen to an attractive mark and may just deny Lillistar a follow-up success. Two-time C&D winner Beat The Retreat also needs a close look in a competitive finale.

  1. WALK ON SON (IRE)
  2. LILLISTAR
  3. BEAT THE RETREAT (IRE)

races.name: Golden Scoop Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The Skelton yard continue to carry all before them so PALAMON is selected to supplement his recent Wetherby success from 7 lb higher. Kayf Dancer showed much more of what he's about at Ffos Las last month so he's taken to edge out Kent de Thaix for the forecast spot.

  1. PALAMON (IRE)
  2. KAYF DANCER
  3. KENT DE THAIX (FR)

races.name: Steve Martin Memorial EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LOW TIDE has a useful jumping pedigree and the booking of top rider Danny McMenamin signals intent, so he's selected to make a successful start to his career. Invino Honnetete carries a penalty for winning on debut at Bordeaux last month and can put his experience to good use, while Navrom is another newcomer to note for a powerful yard.

  1. LOW TIDE (IRE)
  2. INVINO HONNETETE (FR)
  3. NAVROM (FR)

races.name: Ice Cream Direct UK Members Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MATTY'S MATE found only a fellow newcomer too good in a Newton Abbot bumper back in the spring and his pedigree strongly points to him improving on that now switched to hurdling over a longer distance, so he's a straightforward choice to go one better in a thin-looking race. Masterius offered disappointingly little on his recent hurdling debut, so Dshipdatnevrsailed, who was runner-up on his second outing in Irish points, is preferred for forecast purposes.

  1. MATTY'S MATE (IRE)
  2. DSHIPDATNEVRSAILED (IRE)
  3. MASTERIUS (FR)

races.name: Kelly's Dairy Soft Ice Cream Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TOOTHLESS looked as good as ever when making a successful reappearance at Ffos Las last month so Paul Nicholls' consistent 8-y-o gets the nod to follow up at the expense of Cuban Court, who had a productive 2025/26 with 3 wins at this track and is fancied to come forward from his return. The enigmatic Primoz rounds off the shortlist.

  1. TOOTHLESS (FR)
  2. CUBAN COURT (IRE)
  3. PRIMOZ (IRE)

races.name: Cadburys Ice Cream Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NOBODY TOLD ME hacked up at Southwell on Tuesday and can defy a penalty to make it 2-2 for Dan Skelton. Moi Mon Vieux and Blue Sky Dreaming appeal most of the remainder.

  1. NOBODY TOLD ME
  2. MOI MON VIEUX (FR)
  3. BLUE SKY DREAMING

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Progressive ANXIOUS MOMENTS should have no problem making it a hat-trick. Thesoldiersminit may offer most resistance.

  1. ANXIOUS MOMENTS (IRE)
  2. THESOLDIERSMINIT (IRE)
  3. BANNISTER (FR)

races.name: Apres Village At Doncaster Racecourse 'Hands & Heels' Handicap Hurdle (Conditional/Amateurs)
races.verdict:
A trappy race. BRIGHT LEGEND has fallen to a tempting mark and could capitalise if taking up this engagement. Hurdling debutant Sledgehammer has to be feared in his bid to make it 4-4 for Adrian Keatley, with front-running Biglesisback also expected to give a good account.

  1. BRIGHT LEGEND (IRE)
  2. SLEDGEHAMMER (IRE)
  3. BIGLESISBACK

races.name: Coral 'Black Friday Price Boosts' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
PRINCE RUPERT looked something out of the ordinary when making a winning bumper debut at Kempton back in March, a race Nicky Henderson landed with Shishkin a few years earlier. He's an exciting prospect now hurdling with his yard boasting a fine record in this race. Unsurprisingly there is depth in opposition, with dangers headed up by fellow impressive bumper winner River Kwai. Ffos Las second Oatsoeasy and Lover Desbois complete the shortlist.

  1. PRINCE RUPERT
  2. RIVER KWAI (FR)
  3. OATSOEASY (IRE)

races.name: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' For Free 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
STICK TO THE BOARD failed to land the odds on his Chepstow hurdling debut but was still a promising first effort in this sphere in a race that's worked out well, and he's taken to go one better with the return to 2m unlikely to inconvenience him. Octo Gane and useful bumper performer Tally Ho Back head the dangers.

  1. STICK TO THE BOARD (IRE)
  2. OCTO GANE (FR)
  3. TALLY HO BACK

races.name: Coral Racing Club Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for KLUB DE REVE who progressed with each of his 4 starts over hurdles last season, landing a Grade 2 novice at Kempton with a bit in hand on his final outing. He could be capable of even better as a chaser and is fancied to make a successful handicap debut, though Country Mile isn't taken lightly with the form of his Uttoxeter win working out well.

  1. KLUB DE REVE (FR)
  2. COUNTRY MILE (IRE)
  3. MASKED MAN (FR)

races.name: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Fillies' Juvenile Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KOALA ROSE made an impressive start over hurdles with an emphatic success at Hereford, jumping accurately in the main, and she can take this step up in grade in her stride for her leading yard. She gets the vote ahead of Nathalie Jolie who was successful on her only start in France, while Irish raider Espritroyale could also be in the mix.

  1. KOALA ROSE (IRE)
  2. NATHALIE JOLIE
  3. ESPRITROYALE (IRE)

races.name: Coral John Francome Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TAURUS BAY looks likely to take high rank amongst this season's novice chasers on the evidence of his impressive win in the Rising Stars and he can defy a penalty to take his record to 2-2 in this sphere. Tutti Quanti had a very good record here over hurdles and looks the biggest danger, with Royal Infantry also respected having jumped fluently to win a pair of 3-runner races.

  1. TAURUS BAY (IRE)
  2. TUTTI QUANTI (FR)
  3. ROYAL INFANTRY (IRE)

races.name: Coral 'Bet10 Get50 Sign Up Offer' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for a few but ETALON has been in better heart than recent form figures would suggest, far from discredited when a never-nearer fourth at Aintree 3 weeks ago. Back down to his last winning mark with cheekpieces refitted, he could be ready to strike, with confidence behind him in the market likely to bolster that view. Exeter scorer Kap Ouest is easily one of the least exposed and feared on return, with last year's winner Twinjets another expected to play a lead role.

  1. ETALON (IRE)
  2. KAP OUEST (FR)
  3. TWINJETS (IRE)

races.name: Coral Long Distance Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The unbeaten LE FRIMEUR produced a taking display when scoring in Grade 1 company at the Punchestown festival and he might be able to improve beyond some of the more established names in this division, chiefly last season's winner Impose Toi, who also merits consideration given his exemplary record fresh. Ma Shantou is better than he showed at the Cheltenham Festival and would also be foolish to dismiss.

  1. LE FRIMEUR (FR)
  2. IMPOSE TOI (FR)
  3. MA SHANTOU (IRE)

races.name: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Winner of a point and his hurdling debut, WESTERN MONKEY shaped well after 11 months off when finishing mid-field over this C&D 22 days ago and he can build on his reappearance effort to resume winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Harbour Light as he bids for a 5-timer, while Lihyan is another to consider from a handy mark.

  1. WESTERN MONKEY
  2. HARBOUR LIGHT
  3. LIHYAN (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Golden Rose Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
CRESTOFDISTINCTION arrives at the top of his game and is 2 from 2 on all-weather, so has plenty going for him. Soldier's Tree is the obvious threat if back to the level he showed when placed in the Wokingham, while Ain't Nobody responded very well to the switch to all-weather when just failing in a Group 3 at Dundalk and is also respected in what is a strong listed event.

  1. CRESTOFDISTINCTION
  2. SOLDIER'S TREE (IRE)
  3. AIN'T NOBODY (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Churchill Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
MILITARY ORDER is rock solid on this surface and at this level, so should prove hard to beat if over his exertions in the desert. Warrant Holder rates a big threat back down in class, with Spinning Wheel best of the others.

  1. MILITARY ORDER (IRE)
  2. WARRANT HOLDER (IRE)
  3. SPINNING WHEEL

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
An open-looking handicap in which it could pay to side with UNDER THE SUN, who has been finding his feet for James Owen in recent weeks and can take advantage of a much reduced mark sporting a reapplied tongue tie. El Fox will no doubt be popular arriving on a C&D hat-trick so she's put forward as the main danger, with Mr Fustic next best.

  1. UNDER THE SUN
  2. EL FOX
  3. MR FUSTIC (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
GRACIOUS GIFT is worth another chance to confirm debut promise back from a break having chased home subsequent Group 1 winner Musical Times at Yarmouth. Kalypsa and Signora Fortuna head a clutch of interesting newcomers.

  1. GRACIOUS GIFT
  2. KALYPSA (IRE)
  3. SIGNORA FORTUNA (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
PROBING looked potentially useful when just denied in a Newmarket maiden 7 weeks ago and should prove hard to beat. Fredegund and the selection's stablemate Forest Bay are a couple of interesting newcomers to keep an eye on.

  1. PROBING
  2. FREDEGUND (IRE)
  3. FOREST BAY

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Switched to all-weather, FLICK OF AN EYE was the only one to throw down a challenge to the improving winner when runner-up at this course last time and he can build on that effort to go one better. A pair of the newcomers could be the main dangers, Kite Beach representing much respected connections and the pick for second, ahead of Barbossa.

  1. FLICK OF AN EYE (IRE)
  2. KITE BEACH (IRE)
  3. BARBOSSA (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
PUROSANGUE was a good second at Wolverhampton on Tuesday and looks favoured by the terms of this race. He makes most appeal ahead of Moving Force and Bassenthwaite.

  1. PUROSANGUE
  2. MOVING FORCE (IRE)
  3. BASSENTHWAITE

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
A thin race in which the improving SAXOPHONIC looks a clear stand-out. Storm On Jura is worth another chance to back up her Musselburgh win and can pose the biggest threat, with Someone's Wish appealing as best of the rest.

  1. SAXOPHONIC
  2. STORM ON JURA
  3. SOMEONE'S WISH (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
OFF SPIN probably would have made it 2 from 2 for this yard granted a stronger gallop at Lingfield last week and can gain compensation off the same mark. King Chaos hinted at a revival last time so is feared back at a more suitable trip, along with the thriving Spec of Light.

  1. OFF SPIN (IRE)
  2. KING CHAOS (IRE)
  3. SPEC OF LIGHT

races.name: BAR 1 Casino Claiming Race
races.verdict:
REJOINDER hasn't looked suited by the drop to the minimum trip on each of his last 2 starts, so is afforded another chance to confirm his earlier Curragh promise now tackling 7f for the first time. Chicago Caray rates next best ahead of Let Me Free. Support for either of the newcomers Present Perfect and Pal of Mine would also look significant.

  1. REJOINDER (IRE)
  2. CHICAGO CARAY
  3. LET ME FREE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
Hard to get a handle on the newcomers before market clues so RIA'S ANGEL gets the vote having taken a big step forward when not beaten far in fourth over 7f here 3 weeks ago. Joseph O'Brien's Kodiak Gold and Thosegirlsdontplay make plenty of appeal on paper.

  1. RIA'S ANGEL (IRE)
  2. KODIAK GOLD (IRE)
  3. THOSEGIRLSDONTPLAY (IRE)

races.name: Campbell & Haughey Solicitors Nursery Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
This looks an excellent opportunity for INVINCIBLE IRISH who brings easily the most solid profile to the table and he'll find this much less demanding than the assignment he faced when third over 5f here last week. Scarlet Dream and nursery debutant Mirissa Beach may offer chief resistance.

  1. INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE)
  2. SCARLET DREAM (IRE)
  3. MIRISSA BEACH (IRE)

races.name: Killowen Contracts Handicap
races.verdict:
An ultra-competitive sprint in which it could pay to side with GO ATHLETICO, who is clearly not the force of old but fared better dropped in grade when runner-up in a C&D claimer under this rider earlier in the month. Back in a handicap, he can get the better of My Cubby Bear, who failed to build on her return but is one of the least exposed. Stable-switcher Saint Acclaim and Thaloria are another couple to consider, as well.

  1. GO ATHLETICO (FR)
  2. MY CUBBY BEAR (IRE)
  3. SAINT ACCLAIM (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Handicap
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced MURAT should be well suited by all-weather and he's fancied to make it 2 wins from 5 starts on the Flat. The main danger could be Zoffman, who is lurking on a dangerous mark, while Star Harbour looks interesting tackling 2m for the first time.

  1. MURAT (IRE)
  2. ZOFFMAN (IRE)
  3. STAR HARBOUR (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Weekly Rewards' Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
BYE BYE NOW is well drawn to attack and can land a second C&D success. The Love Machine shades One Cool Bear for next best.

  1. BYE BYE NOW (IRE)
  2. THE LOVE MACHINE (IRE)
  3. ONE COOL BEAR (IRE)

races.name: Saddle Cocktail Bar At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on RIYAZANKA to live up to her pedigree from what could be a generous opening mark. Love Orchid and Movin And Groovin appeal as the main dangers.

  1. RIYAZANKA (IRE)
  2. LOVE ORCHID (IRE)
  3. MOVIN AND GROOVIN (IRE)
